WITH -- amount: sum of amount in Sales orders (SAP S/4)
s1 AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(src.customer AS TEXT), ''), '(blank)') AS customer,
         SUM(src.amount) AS agg_value
  FROM sales_orders AS src
  GROUP BY 1
),
-- one row per group
t AS (
  SELECT x1.customer,
         x1.agg_value AS "amount"
  FROM s1 AS x1
)
SELECT customer,
       "amount"
FROM t
ORDER BY "amount" DESC NULLS LAST, customer
LIMIT 12;

cases.title: count and average
cases.sql:
-- Each source is totalled on its own first, then joined on region; ratios use the totals.
WITH -- Sales orders (count): number of rows in Sales orders (SAP S/4)
s1 AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(src.region AS TEXT), ''), '(blank)') AS region,
         COUNT(*) AS agg_value
  FROM sales_orders AS src
  GROUP BY 1
),
-- Avg order: avg of amount in Sales orders (SAP S/4)
s2 AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(src.region AS TEXT), ''), '(blank)') AS region,
         AVG(src.amount) AS agg_value
  FROM sales_orders AS src
  GROUP BY 1
),
-- every region found in any source
labels AS (
  SELECT region FROM s1
  UNION
  SELECT region FROM s2
),
-- one row per group
t AS (
  SELECT l.region,
         x1.agg_value AS "Sales orders (count)",
         x2.agg_value AS "Avg order"
  FROM labels AS l
  LEFT JOIN s1 AS x1 ON x1.region = l.region
  LEFT JOIN s2 AS x2 ON x2.region = l.region
)
SELECT region,
       "Sales orders (count)",
       "Avg order"
FROM t
ORDER BY "Sales orders (count)" DESC NULLS LAST, region
LIMIT 12;

-- Each source is totalled on its own first, then joined on customer; ratios use the totals.
WITH -- Invoiced: sum of amount in Invoices (Billing)
s1 AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(src.customer AS TEXT), ''), '(blank)') AS customer,
         SUM(src.amount) AS agg_value
  FROM invoices AS src
  GROUP BY 1
),
-- Pipeline: sum of amount in Opportunities (Salesforce)
s2 AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(src.customer AS TEXT), ''), '(blank)') AS customer,
         SUM(src.amount) AS agg_value
  FROM opportunities AS src
  WHERE COALESCE(lower(src.stage), '') <> 'closed lost'
  GROUP BY 1
),
-- Orders: sum of amount in Sales orders (SAP S/4)
s3 AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(src.customer AS TEXT), ''), '(blank)') AS customer,
         SUM(src.amount) AS agg_value
  FROM sales_orders AS src
  GROUP BY 1
),
-- every customer found in any source
labels AS (
  SELECT customer FROM s1
  UNION
  SELECT customer FROM s2
  UNION
  SELECT customer FROM s3
),
-- one row per group
t AS (
  SELECT l.customer,
         x1.agg_value AS "Invoiced",
         x2.agg_value AS "Pipeline",
         x3.agg_value AS "Orders",
         CAST(COALESCE(x1.agg_value, 0) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COALESCE(x3.agg_value, 0), 0) AS "Invoiced per order £"
  FROM labels AS l
  LEFT JOIN s1 AS x1 ON x1.customer = l.customer
  LEFT JOIN s2 AS x2 ON x2.customer = l.customer
  LEFT JOIN s3 AS x3 ON x3.customer = l.customer
)
SELECT customer,
       "Invoiced",
       "Pipeline",
       "Orders",
       "Invoiced per order £"
FROM t
ORDER BY "Invoiced per order £" DESC NULLS LAST, customer
LIMIT 12;

cases.title: lookup through a link (expenses by the employee department)

-- Each source is totalled on its own first, then joined on department; ratios use the totals.
WITH -- amount: sum of amount in Expenses (Concur)
s1 AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(l1.department AS TEXT), ''), '(blank)') AS department,
         SUM(src.amount) AS agg_value
  FROM expenses AS src
  LEFT JOIN ( -- one row per employee_id in Employees (SuccessFactors)
    SELECT lower(trim(CAST(employee_id AS TEXT))) AS link_key, MIN(department) AS department
    FROM employees
    WHERE trim(COALESCE(CAST(employee_id AS TEXT), '')) <> ''
    GROUP BY 1
  ) AS l1 ON l1.link_key = lower(trim(CAST(src.employee_id AS TEXT)))
  GROUP BY 1
),
-- Headcount: number of rows in Employees (SuccessFactors)
s2 AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(src.department AS TEXT), ''), '(blank)') AS department,
         COUNT(*) AS agg_value
  FROM employees AS src
  GROUP BY 1
),
-- every department found in any source
labels AS (
  SELECT department FROM s1
  UNION
  SELECT department FROM s2
),
-- one row per group
t AS (
  SELECT l.department,
         x1.agg_value AS "amount",
         x2.agg_value AS "Headcount"
  FROM labels AS l
  LEFT JOIN s1 AS x1 ON x1.department = l.department

cases.title: Orders by month, 3-month rolling
cases.sql:
-- Rolling 3 months: each month adds up the raw totals of that month and the 2 before it.
WITH -- Orders: sum of amount in Sales orders (SAP S/4)
s1 AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(src.month AS TEXT), ''), '(blank)') AS month,
         COUNT(*) AS agg_rows, COUNT(src.amount) AS agg_count, SUM(src.amount) AS agg_sum, MIN(src.amount) AS agg_min, MAX(src.amount) AS agg_max
  FROM sales_orders AS src
  GROUP BY 1
),
-- every month found in any source
labels AS (
  SELECT month, CASE WHEN month GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' THEN CAST(substr(month, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) * 12 + CAST(substr(month, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) END AS month_idx
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT month FROM s1
  ) AS u
),
r1 AS (
  SELECT l.month, CASE WHEN SUM(x.agg_count) > 0 THEN SUM(x.agg_sum) END AS agg_value
  FROM labels AS l
  LEFT JOIN labels AS w ON w.month_idx BETWEEN l.month_idx - 2 AND l.month_idx
  LEFT JOIN s1 AS x ON x.month = w.month
  GROUP BY l.month, l.month_idx
),
-- one row per group
t AS (
  SELECT l.month, l.month_idx,
         x1.agg_value AS "Orders (3-mo rolling)"
  FROM labels AS l
  LEFT JOIN r1 AS x1 ON x1.month = l.month
)
SELECT month,
       "Orders (3-mo rolling)"
FROM t
ORDER BY month;
